domain258.name: Maskera privacy-safe Swedish domain regression corpus
domain258.scoring: Strict material-character survival: full hit removes every Unicode letter or digit of the annotated value.

gold121PerOnly.name: Maskera synthetic hand-authored Swedish gold set (PER entities only for cross-taxonomy fairness)
gold121PerOnly.scoring: Overlap match on the 87 Swedish PER spans (both original casing and all-lowercase). Used alongside the full 258-text domain suite because openai/privacy-filter does not label standalone LOC or ORG entities.

systems.name: OpenAI Privacy Filter (q4 ONNX)
systems.notes: 1.5B MoE (50M active params), 128k context, constrained BIOES Viterbi decoding. Includes a dedicated secret/API-key class that Maskera does not target, but does not label standalone LOC/ORG and struggles with Swedish names (especially lowercase) and Swedish structured formats.

systems.name: Microsoft Presidio (Swedish spaCy sv_core_news_lg + Swedish rules)
systems.notes: Steelmanned Swedish setup: mapped spaCy PRS->PERSON, LOC->LOCATION, ORG->ORGANIZATION and explicitly registered SePersonnummerRecognizer, SeOrganisationsnummerRecognizer, Email, Phone, CreditCard, Iban, Ip and Url for language='sv'.

systems.name: LogosGuard (Chrome Free, Balanced)
systems.notes: Measured in docs/benchmark-logosguard-2.4.4.json on the exact same 258-text corpus.
